 "data": "%%{init: {\"flowchart\": {\"nodeSpacing\": 25, \"rankSpacing\": 35, \"padding\": 8, \"curve\": \"basis\"}}}%%
flowchart TB
 subgraph Simulators[\"Эмуляторы\"]
 TERM[\"Terminal Sim :8085\"]
 MERCH[\"Merchant+Acquirer Sim :8084\"]
 end
 subgraph GatewayLayer[\"API Gateway\"]
 GW[\"Gateway :8080\"]
 end
 subgraph Core[\"Core Processing\"]
 SW[\"Switch :8082\"]
 AUTH[\"Authorization :8083\"]
 CMS[\"Card Management :8081<br/>+ outbox\"]
 end
 subgraph External[\"External API\"]
 BIN[\"Bin Lookup :8096\"]
 end
 subgraph Notif[\"Notifications\"]
 NS[\"Notification :8097\"]
 end
 subgraph LoggingLayer[\"Logging\"]
 LOG[\"Transaction Logger :8088<br/>+ WebSocket\"]
 end
 subgraph Frontend[\"Frontend\"]
 WEB[\"Web Dashboard :3000\"]
 end
 subgraph Infra[\"Infrastructure\"]
 DB[(\"PostgreSQL :5432\")]
 RMQ{{\"RabbitMQ :5672<br/>smp.transactions → transaction-log<br/>smp.card-events → card-notifications<br/>+ DLX/DLQ\"}}
 ASC[\"autoscaler<br/>profile observability<br/>вне потока\"]
 end

 %% исходные связи architecture-diagram.puml (0-11)
 TERM -->|\"HTTP\"| GW
 MERCH -->|\"HTTP\"| GW
 GW -->|\"HTTP /route\"| SW
 SW -->|\"HTTP /authorize, /rollback\"| AUTH
 AUTH -->|\"HTTP /api/bin\"| BIN
 AUTH -->|\"HTTP card, reserve\"| CMS
 CMS -->|\"JDBC\"| DB
 NS -->|\"JDBC\"| DB
 LOG -->|\"JDBC\"| DB
 AUTH -->|\"JDBC\"| DB
 WEB -->|\"REST\"| GW
 WEB -->|\"WebSocket\"| LOG

 %% исходные связи через RabbitMQ, теперь async (12-15)
 SW -.->|\"A1 publish + confirms\"| RMQ
 RMQ -.->|\"A1 consume\"| LOG
 CMS -.->|\"A2 outbox publish\"| RMQ
 RMQ -.->|\"A2 consume\"| NS

 %% ДОБАВЛЕНО: пропущенные sync-связи (16-22)
 GW -->|\"HTTP /api/cards\"| CMS
 GW -->|\"HTTP logs, dashboard\"| LOG
 GW -->|\"HTTP\"| TERM
 GW -->|\"HTTP\"| MERCH
 SW -->|\"HTTP /fee\"| MERCH
 TERM -->|\"HTTP /api/cards\"| CMS
 MERCH -->|\"JDBC\"| DB
